complexity_scope.guarantee: Per-instance expected error uniformly over the stated class; worst-instance expected raw query cost. No universal quantile guarantee or almost-sure stopping budget is asserted.
complexity_scope.hidden_constants: Numerical implementation constants; initialization and accuracy enter logarithms. Normalized expressions additionally depend on constants in C_f,L_f,L_g=O(L).
complexity_scope.oracle: Definition 3.2 fresh same-point full-gradient pair with conditional unbiasedness and separate variances; no sample reuse or free inner optimum.
complexity_scope.output_and_metric: xhat∈R^{d_x}; expected Euclidean hypergradient norm E||∇F(xhat)||≤ε.
complexity_scope.regime: Unexpanded bound under stated finite budgets; normalized leading rate only at sufficiently high accuracy with structural budgets fixed.
complexity_scope.resource: Count every original paired SFO call, including all inner SGD samples, direction estimation and distinct final batches. Arithmetic and projection are not additional SFO calls.
complexity_scope.upper_witness_or_lower_coverage: Existential upper witness: Algorithm 1 with Lemma B.1 inner solves and batches, outer updates x+=x−G/Λ, and uniform outer-iterate output. Not a performance claim about every adaptive algorithm.

content.intended_use: Supply the upper witness under Assumption 3.1 and a finite initialization certificate.

map: Use t=1 if Eρ=0, otherwise min{1,ε/(128Eρ)}; the linked deterministic bias theorem bounds ideal tilt bias.

Lemma B.1: solve the untilted and frozen-direction tilted lower objectives to distance MSE r0² and rt², with r0=ε/[C((1+k)L_f+L_g/t)] and rt=εt/(CL_g). Estimate f_y with a fresh batch of size ceil(C(1+k)²σ_f²/ε²)∨1 and project onto the C_f ball. Final f_x batch size is ceil(Cσ_f²/ε²)∨1; each of the two independent g_x batches has size ceil(Cσ_g²/(t²ε²))∨1.

Projection and direction stability control direction error; evaluation errors propagate by (L_f+L_g/t)||yhat0−y0||+(L_g/t)||yhatt−y_t(ahat)||+k||ahat−a0||. Together with ideal bias and final sampling, conditional MSE is at most ε²/16.

Epoch SGD inner cost for squared distance r² is O(1+(L_g/μ)log_+(Rstart²/r²)+σ_g²/(μ²r²)). Tilt is fixed throughout each solve and preserves strong convexity/smoothness. At target distance D² use step min{1/(2L_g),μD²/(8σ_g²)} with geometric distance epochs, interpreting zero variance by the deterministic step. Substitution and all batches give equation (40).
True F-smoothness gives F(x+)≤F(x)−||∇F(x)||²/(2Λ)+||G−∇F(x)||²/(2Λ). Telescope for O(1+ΛΔ/ε²) outer steps and select uniformly; Jensen yields the expected norm target.

For later inner solves the starting radius is bounded using R0+k||x−x0||+tC_f/μ. The source controls accumulated outer travel and places initialization dependence inside logarithms. Multiply per-step cost by outer count to obtain (41).

assumptions: Globally, g(x,·) is μ-strongly convex, ||f_y(x,y)||≤C_f, Lip(∇f)≤L_f, Lip(∇g)≤L_g, and g_yy,g_xy are jointly ρ-Lipschitz in (x,y).
F(x0)−inf F≤Δ and a supplied y_init satisfies ||y_init−y*(x0)||≤R0<∞.

Each adaptive SFO query returns only a fresh pair of full gradients at the queried point, conditionally unbiased given history with separate variance bounds σ_f²,σ_g² globally. No independence within the returned pair is needed. Independent fresh calls are used for the two final g_x batches.
Regularity, variance, gap, initialization and tuning bounds are public; exact inner optima, exact hypergradients, HVPs and same-sample multiple-point evaluations are not oracle permissions.
statement.conclusion: Expected raw SFO cost is Otilde((1+ΛΔ/ε²){1+k+((1+k)²/ε²)[σ_f²+(L_f²/μ²+1+Eρ²/ε²)σ_g²]}). Otilde suppresses accuracy and initialization logarithms. A universal valid choice is Λ=(1+k)²(L_f+ρC_f/μ). With C_f,L_f,L_g=O(L), κ=L/μ and θ=ρ/μ, the high-accuracy expansion is Otilde(L(1+θ)κ³Δε^−2+L(1+θ)κ⁴σ_f²Δε^−4+L(1+θ)κ⁶σ_g²Δε^−4+L³θ²(1+θ)κ⁸σ_g²Δε^−6). For θ≳1 its leading coefficient is χ³κ⁸, whereas the general-class lower coefficient is χ²κ⁸.
statement.objects_and_definitions: x∈R^{d_x}, y∈R^{d_y}, Euclidean norms; y*(x)=argmin_y g(x,y), F(x)=f(x,y*(x)). Let k=L_g/μ, Eρ=(1+k)ρC_f²/(2μ²), and a public valid Λ>0 with Λ≥Lip(∇F).
statement.parameter_domains: μ>0, L_g≥μ, finite positive L_f,C_f,Λ, ε>0; Δ,R0,ρ,σ_f,σ_g are finite and nonnegative. Zero-noise or zero-variation cases use the unexpanded formula with its additive terms. Normalized asymptotic comparisons require their separately stated parameter and high-accuracy regimes.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: For every finite-dimensional instance and oracle satisfying these budgets, there exists the source fresh-SFO algorithm producing xhat with E||∇F(xhat)||≤ε. Expectation includes oracle randomness and uniform selection of an outer iterate. The resource is worst-instance expected raw calls for the stated public budgets, not an asserted almost-sure call cap.
